message: 怪段

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, you're late. I've been waiting.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? What are you doing at my house...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Isn't it obvious?」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it! You want to start a home garden too, Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「When making seedbeds, it's great to use empty detergent boxes. Since they're waterproof, they're perfect as temporary pots until the seeds sprout.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huuuh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are plenty of empty boxes in the shed, so take whichever ones you like.」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want them! The only reason I'd ever visit you is obviously for Student Council business!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, right...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't slump your shoulders like you're disappointed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on in.」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me for intruding.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? If you want to fix your boots from losing their shape, roll up some old newspaper and stuff it inside--」

name: Misa
message: 「I wasn't thinking about anything like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you looked like you were worried about something?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's nothing as dramatic as that. It's just...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, why don't you live on the second floor? It gets better sunlight and would be safer, wouldn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, there's no deep reason behind it. If I had to say, since I'm the caretaker here, shouldn't I stay in the room right next to the first-floor entrance?」

name: Misa
message: 「Caretaker... even though nobody lives here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh...! E-Even so, it apparently had quite a few residents way back when, you know? According to my dad, people were constantly coming and going on the second floor.」

name: Misa
message: 「Were there a lot of students, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Who knows? Though apparently most of them ended up moving out within half a month.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's way too short. Canceling their lease after just two weeks--what on earth is going--」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-I'll be taking my leave!」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't even heard what you came here for yet?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh, you figured it out, didn't you, Hiss? The staircase at Grand Palace Sakura has exactly 14 steps, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't say it, Paqy-san!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is there something special about that, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When you stay on the second floor, on the very first night, you hear a voice from far away going... 'Up one step, I'm so happy'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Late at night on the second day, the voice is still far off, but clearer than the first day... 'Up two steps, I'm so happy'」

name: Paqy
message: 「The tenant can't help but realize it--that the owner of the voice is down at the bottom of the stairs. Yet they can't see anyone there at all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the dead of night on the 11th day, coming from near the top of the stairs... 'Three steps left, I'm so happy'」

name: Paqy
message: 「And then on the final 14th day... on the night it finishes climbing the stairs and steps onto the second floor--」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaaaah--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh! I-It hurts, Misa... Don't cling to me so hard.」

name: Misa
message: 「Noooo--, stoooop--! Don't coooome--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... g-guh... M-My lungs... I-I can't... breathe...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nooooooo--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... my vision's... turning gray... It's so dark, Dad...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Huh? Is this... my room...?」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Geez... You really are hopeless. Starting a nap right in the middle of our meeting.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right... If I recall, Misa came over to my house about Student Council business...」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, what happened after that?」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Come on, remember? The two of us put together ideas for the Holy Night Festival, didn't we?」

name: Misa
message: 「The second we finished, you came down with a brain fever and went straight to bed, Sakura-kun. That's why you don't remember.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it went? Sorry for causing you trouble. I'm a failure as president.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-Th-Th-That's not true at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? You're unusually docile today. That's not like you.」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! I am always docile!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, Hisa's actually super obedient at her core, ya know? Hehehe... That's why she totally bought that 'staircase scare-case' ghost story I made up on the spot.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Long ago, a demon with crazy loud snoring lived on the second floor here. Because of all that noise pollution, everyone ended up moving out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? A staircase scare-case? A pun? The second floor? H-Hmm...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nghh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!? I remember now, Misa! If I'm not mistaken, you--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't you dare remember!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hauh!? Guh... N-Not again... Guh... Ggh... Can't...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if it was unavoidable, I refuse to admit that Sakura-kun and I hugged each other!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa... stop... I-I can't breathe...」

name: Misa
message: 「If you want me to stop, then pass out again and forget everything! Hiyah, bearhug!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... My vision... is turning black... It's so cold, Mom...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just to point this out, Hisa was the only one doing the hugging there, ya know? You can't really call that 'hugging each other.'」
